posting.title: Data Engineer, Logistics Analytics (mid-level)
posting.text:
Requirements
- 3+ years of Python and SQL
- Built and maintained batch data pipelines that other teams rely on
- Hands-on with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake or BigQuery), including designing data models for analytics
- Own your pipelines in production: scheduling, data-quality checks and the on-call rota
- Strong stakeholder management

Nice to have
- Airflow or Dagster
- Streaming data with Kafka
- A track record of cutting pipeline cost or runtime
- Logistics or supply-chain experience
- Mentoring analysts on SQL

facts.text: Member of the central data team
Build and maintain the Python pipelines that load parcel scans into Snowflake for the planning team
Designed the delivery warehouse models: chose the fact and dimension tables and how they join
Schedule and run my pipelines myself in Airflow and fix failed loads
Rewrote the slowest SQL transformations and cut the nightly run from 90 to 30 minutes
Built Excel reports for store managers
